title: IRS home
purpose: Main portal for federal tax information, forms and online tools.

title: IRS Payments
purpose: Lists the official ways to pay federal taxes.

title: IRS Direct Pay
purpose: Pays federal taxes from a checking or savings account with no enrollment.
notes: IRS Direct Pay help page (irs.gov/payments/direct-pay-help) states up to five payments per 24 hours; no enrollment required.

title: IRS Online Account for Individuals
purpose: Lets individuals view balances, payment history and payment plans and make payments.
notes: IRS recommends individuals use Direct Pay or Online Account; per IRS EFTPS page, individuals can no longer create new EFTPS enrollments as of Oct 17, 2025.

title: IRS Business Tax Account
purpose: Lets authorized business officials view business tax account information, manage access and make payments.
notes: Short link irs.gov/businessaccount cited by IRS (in-text). Sign-in via ID.me or Login.gov.

title: Where's My Refund?
purpose: Checks the status of a federal individual income tax refund.
notes: Info page: https://www.irs.gov/refunds/about-wheres-my-refund. Tool is for individual returns.

title: EFTPS (Electronic Federal Tax Payment System)
purpose: Free Treasury system for scheduling federal tax payments, mainly for businesses.
agency: U.S. Department of the Treasury / IRS
notes: IRS description page: https://www.irs.gov/payments/eftps-the-electronic-federal-tax-payment-system. New individual enrollments ended Oct 17, 2025 per IRS page.

title: SBA home
purpose: Main portal for SBA loans, disaster assistance and small business resources.

title: Make an SBA loan payment
purpose: Explains how to pay SBA-serviced loans, including through the MySBA Loan Portal.
notes: Search result also showed https://www.sba.gov/loans/make-payment-sba/. Per search summary SBA stopped accepting paper checks Oct 1, 2025 - confirm on page.

title: MySBA Loan Portal
purpose: Online portal where borrowers view and pay SBA-serviced loans including COVID EIDL.
notes: lending.sba.gov is named on sba.gov payment/EIDL pages per search results; the portal URL itself was not returned as a search result.

title: Manage your COVID EIDL
purpose: Explains servicing, payments, payoff and hardship options for COVID-19 EIDL loans.

title: SBA Answer Desk
purpose: General SBA questions line.
notes: Listed on sba.gov Contact SBA page (also 1-800-U-ASK-SBA, answerdesk@sba.gov). Not fetched; seen in search excerpt.

title: SBA Disaster Assistance Customer Service Center
purpose: Questions about SBA disaster loans (non-COVID).
notes: Listed on sba.gov Contact SBA and disaster pages; email shown as disastercustomerservice@sba.gov or DCS@sba.gov (sources differ).

title: COVID-19 EIDL Customer Service
purpose: Servicing and payoff questions on existing COVID EIDL loans.
notes: Number appeared in search summary of sba.gov EIDL/payment pages; not fetched. Email COVIDEIDLServicing@sba.gov (older pages: CESC@sba.gov).

title: MySBA Customer Service (portal technical help)
purpose: Technical help with the MySBA Loan Portal; cannot access loan details.
notes: Number appeared in search summary of sba.gov payment pages; not fetched. Email cls@sba.gov.

title: SAM.gov entity registration
purpose: Starts registration of an entity and obtaining a Unique Entity ID to do business with the federal government.

title: Unique Entity ID and entity information
purpose: Explains the Unique Entity ID and entity registration information.
notes: Same entity-registration page covers getting a UEI with or without full registration.

title: Renew/update entity registration
purpose: Guide to updating or renewing an entity registration, which must be renewed every 365 days.
notes: Federal Service Desk (FSD.gov, GSA) Quick Start Guide for Updating Entity Registrations. Updates/renewals are done in the Entity Workspace after signing in at https://sam.gov/.

title: Contract Opportunities
purpose: Searches federal contract opportunities posted by agencies.

title: SAM.gov registration is free
purpose: Official statement that getting a UEI and registering/maintaining registration costs nothing.
notes: Entity Registration Checklist states: 'SAM.gov is FREE to use. There is no charge to get a Unique Entity ID, register your entity, and maintain your entity registration.'

title: Alabama Department of Revenue
purpose: State agency for Alabama tax information, forms and payments.

title: My Alabama Taxes (MAT)
purpose: ADOR online system for filing certain returns, making payments and corresponding with ADOR.
notes: Named on ADOR pages (e.g. https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/individual-corporate/my-alabama-taxes-sign-up/); portal URL itself not returned as a search result.

title: What MAT handles (ADOR ONE SPOT)
purpose: Describes MAT as the electronic filing/remittance system for state, and state-administered local, sales, use, rental and lodgings taxes.
notes: ADOR pages also say MAT supports individual income tax payments/payment plans, withholding and business privilege tax filing. Seen in search excerpts, not fetched.

title: ADOR Make A Payment
purpose: Lists ways to pay Alabama taxes including MAT.
notes: Phone (Taxpayer Assistance Group, phone payments) appeared in search summary of this page; not fetched.

title: Alabama Business Privilege Tax
purpose: Explains who files the business privilege tax (Forms BPT-IN, PPT, CPT) and how to file.
notes: Administered by ADOR, not the Secretary of State. Can be filed in MAT.

title: Alabama Secretary of State - Start or Dissolve a Business
purpose: Explains forming, registering and dissolving business entities in Alabama.
notes: Forms: https://www.sos.alabama.gov/business-entities/business-downloads ; foreign entities: https://www.sos.alabama.gov/business-entities/foreign-corporations

title: ABC Board license types and fees
purpose: Lists Alabama alcohol license types and fees.

title: ABC Board online services (license renewal)
purpose: Online services including annual license renewal.
notes: Renewal portal: https://onlineordering.alabcboard.gov/license-renewal. Phone is the central office number from an ABC licensee letter (alabcboard.gov PDF, 2023); not fetched. New applications start with Pre-Application Form LCD-1.

title: ABC Board wine tax returns (Tax & Trade Practices)
purpose: Monthly table wine tax returns and remittance filed with the ABC Board.
notes: ABC Board instructions (rev. 01/2026) say wholesaler table wine tax returns are remitted to the ABC Board; division email audit@abc.alabama.gov. Liquor is sold through the ABC Board's control system (markup and taxes collected by ABC). Phone from search excerpt; not fetched.

title: Beer excise tax (who collects)
purpose: State beer excise tax paid by wholesalers.
notes: Conflicting ADOR sources: 2019 General Summary says file with ADOR Business & License Tax Division (Severance and License Section) within 20 days after month end; 2013/2020 summaries say 'Paid to Alcoholic Beverage Control Board'. Confirm with ADOR/ABC before publishing. ADOR collects sales tax on alcohol and the beer/wine WRAP resale report via MAT.

title: Jefferson County Department of Revenue
purpose: County department handling county sales/use taxes and business licenses.

title: Jefferson County Sales & Use Tax
purpose: County sales and use tax information; returns are filed through MAT using locality code 7037.
notes: County notice: https://www.jccal.org/m/newsflash/Home/Detail/78 (pay via MAT). Phone and locality code from search excerpts; not fetched.

title: Jefferson County Business Tax Returns / business license
purpose: County business tax return forms and business license application information.
notes: Online license renewal reportedly at srt.jccal.org (in-text, not confirmed as a result). New businesses submit an Application for Tax or License Number. City of Birmingham taxes/licenses are separate (city self-administers).

title: Birmingham Tax and License Division
purpose: City office for business licenses and city-administered taxes.
agency: City of Birmingham Finance Department - Tax and License Division
notes: Phone and email BhamTLSupport@birminghamal.gov from search excerpt of city pages. New business licenses require City Hall visit per city page.

title: Birmingham online business tax and license portal
purpose: Online filing and payment of Birmingham business license renewals and city taxes (sales, use, lodging, occupational, etc.).
agency: City of Birmingham Finance Department - Tax and License Division
notes: Named on birminghamal.gov pages (HdL Companies portal). Birmingham is self-administered; ADOR 2024 notice says Birmingham sales/use may also be remitted via MAT with city-issued account number: https://www.revenue.alabama.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Birmingham_20240925-1.pdf

title: Birmingham eServices
purpose: City list of online services, including business tax and license services.
notes: City Finance page says from July 1, 2026 tax payments accepted only online or in person (not by mail) - per search excerpt.
